motivation: r1/r2: models picking winners had AUC ~0.5; daily-ribbon gating added most value; 4h EMA20/200 ribbon long was the strongest rule. Test fixed risk/sizing variants of the trend rule, plus one model-sizing variant.
windows: same as pattern_lab_r1 (walk-forward 2021-01-01..2025-09-13, validation 2024-01-01..2025-09-13, opened-year check 2025-09-24..2026-09-22 once)
disclosure: Variant A equals ma_ribbon_r1 grid config 4h_EMA20/200_ribbon_long whose opened-year result (+22.4%) was already seen. Variants B-G were not evaluated on the opened year before this registration.

definitions.entry_4h: 4h close > EMA20 > EMA200 (long) or close < EMA20 < EMA200 (short); exit when the condition ends
definitions.daily_ribbon: last closed daily bar: +1 if close > SMA50 > SMA200, -1 if close < SMA50 < SMA200, else 0
definitions.vol_target: size = min(1, 0.60 / (std of last 30 daily log returns * sqrt(365))) read at entry

variants.E: B longs + 4h shorts entered only if daily_ribbon == -1, vol_target size
variants.G: F with model size: HGB regressor (max_depth=3, lr=0.03, 300 iters, min_samples_leaf=30, l2=1, random_state=0) on pattern_pipeline 'all' features + side at entry predicts primary trade net return; walk-forward refit every 540 bars from 2021-01-01, trainable if exit fill + 12 bars < refit bar; size 1.0 if prediction > 0 else 0.25; before the first fit size 1.0

costs: ma_ribbon_r1 normal / stress / actual funding; fixed quantity at entry
selection: among variants with walk-forward stress net > 0 and walk-forward intrabar DD <= 25%, choose highest validation Sharpe (normal); if none qualify, report failure

acceptance.opened_year_check: selected variant: net > 0 normal and stress, intrabar DD <= 20%; all variants reported
acceptance.then: freeze selected variant for prospective shadow; no live orders; 3% monthly is aspiration only
